comparisons.reason: The two features measure different constructs, even though both read title, argument and OC_comments and return a binary 1/0/null. Feature 0 returns 1 if any comment directly argues against or rebuts the OP's view, which is a stance-based challenge. Feature 1 returns 1 if any comment contains a verbatim or near-verbatim quotation of OP title or argument text, and endorsement or refutation is explicitly irrelevant. A comment can counterargue without quoting, and a comment can quote without counterarguing, so the extraction functions are not the same.
